versions.changelog:
Initial release: Unified Gmail and Outlook multi-account management with secure login, email read/send/search, and command-line workflow.

- Supports unified access to Gmail, Outlook, and Exchange with secure OAuth, API Token, or environment variable authentication.
- Enables email reading, searching, sending, replying, forwarding, and management (mark read/unread, labels, delete) via CLI.
- Stores credentials securely in system keychain; persistent login without repeated authentication.
- Optimized for AI use cases with compact JSON output to reduce token usage.
- Comprehensive examples, best practices, troubleshooting, and quick command reference included in the documentation.
- Targets individual users and small teams needing streamlined multi-provider email workflows for free.
